description: This file defines the Affiliate controller class for the Opencart system, handling account affiliate related actions such as displaying the affiliate information page and processing form submissions for updating or creating affiliate data.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling affiliate-related actions in the account section, including displaying and saving affiliate information.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the affiliate information page. Loads language, checks login status, retrieves affiliate data, and prepares the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to save or update affiliate details. Validates input data, updates the database, and redirects accordingly.
